title: artemisia spicata subsp. eriantha
intro: Artemisia spicata subsp. eriantha, commonly known as Western mugwort, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family and is native to North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting digestion. The therapeutic actions of Western mugwort include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can be used to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and other health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
